description:
**TSP biased random-key evolution with a local decoder.** Use a symmetric distance matrix. Each individual carries one random key per vertex. Sorting keys yields a permutation, which 2-opt improves during phenotype evaluation.

Rank keys by the cost of the improved phenotype. Retain two elites from eight individuals. Generate children using independent biased choices from an elite and a nonelite parent, then add one independent mutant. The improved tour shapes selection without overwriting the parent's keys.

The project decoder adds 2-opt to illustrate the published BRKGA interface. The finite iteration budget and population parameters apply only to this reference.
